purpose: development study, round 2: adds the hybrid (stayers by repeat measurement, movers by their own residuals with the shipped calibration); same scenarios, seeds and draws as round 1

L4.note: normal; variance rises away from the mean wage; worker-specific variances (CV 1.5, as estimated within stayers)
